{{Top|leg}}
The '''Kishh district''' was a region of [[Braad]], a continent located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]]. After [[Human/Legends|Human]] colonists from the [[Bakur Mining Corporation]] established their rule over the world, most members of Bakura's native [[Kurtzen]] [[Species/Legends|species]] settled in the Kissh district. The species enjoyed some autonomy there, but they were still subject to Bakuran law.
